title: Canva for teachers
why: Worksheets, slides and classroom displays take hours. Templates turn that into minutes, and better visuals help students understand.
what_is_different: Teaching materials must suit an age group, print well in black and white, work for students with additional needs, and be reused every year.

extra_modules.title: Worksheets and visual aids
extra_modules.outcome: You can: design printable worksheets that work in black and white
extra_modules.practice: Make a worksheet and test-print it in greyscale

starter_project: Build a unit pack: lesson slides, two worksheets, a classroom poster and certificates generated in bulk from a class list.
pitfalls: Colour-only meaning that disappears when printed
Fonts too small for young readers

expert_validation.note: AI-drafted outline; to be validated by a practitioner and an educator in this field.
